semiconductor_relevance: High — Hirose SER Inc. specializes in semiconductor test probes and sockets, making it a key player in the testing phase of semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Hirose SER Inc. is a global supplier of semiconductor test probes and sockets, providing custom design and engineering solutions for advanced testing requirements. Their offerings include millimeter-wave interposers and cleaning solutions for probe cards, aimed at enhancing performance and yield in semiconductor testing.
capabilities: Millimeter-wave interposer for high-frequency device testing
Customizable solder-less IC sockets for PCB mounting
Gel-Probe cleaning and polishing sheets for probe card maintenance
